messages:
Nora Li: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: customer RFP asking for KMS/BYOK, VPC connectivity, and audit evidence. Can leadership confirm what we can promise and timelines? Pinging @Vikram @Emily.

Vikram Rao: Short answers: BYOK cross-account for Dedicated = pilot in Q3, GA Q4. Private (VPC/on-prem) adapter planned for next quarter after GA. Automated key rollover = staging Q4. Audit export connectors (S3/Kafka/Syslog) = beta Q4.

Emily Nguyen: For compliance artifacts: we provide company SOC2 Type II report, ISO cert, control-mapping CSV, and a per-customer evidence bundle (configs, IAM/KMS policies, audit extracts) for Dedicated/Private. Evidence-bundle export via Console targeted beta end of Q4.

Jess Ortega: Implementation note: BYOK uses a challenge-response flow; we never ingest private key material. For S3 exports we support SSE-KMS using customer keys when writing into customer buckets. Docs snippet to include.

Nora Li: Customer wants 2-year immutable log retention + SSE-KMS. Can we support that as an option?

Vikram Rao: Yes, via export to customer S3 with lifecycle/immutability settings (object lock) and SSE-KMS. We'll include guidance and an IAM role snippet in the RFP appendix.

Sales Bot: RFP template item: "Evidence bundle + export options (S3/Kafka), BYOK support timeline, retention/pricing table" added to tracker.

Emily Nguyen: Note for RFP language: we can't offer per-customer SOC2 attestations; we provide the company attestation and per-customer evidence bundle. Call out that legal/security review required for BYOK copy.

Jess Ortega: Action items: 1) PRD + pilot sign-up (Vikram) 2) RFP appendix draft + IAM snippets (Jess) 3) Evidence bundle sample (Emily). I'll post links here when live.

Vikram Rao: Will post dates by EOD Friday. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
